question: Should ClawHub adopt and maintain this retained catalog-distribution state now, before a signed transport endpoint and supported consumer are approved?
rationale: The implementation introduces a new durable protocol foundation and public schema exports; source review cannot determine whether the project wants to carry that compatibility surface ahead of the dependent transport and consumer work.

options.title: Defer the protocol foundation
options.body: Pause this draft until maintainers approve an end-to-end catalog-feed consumer and transport plan.

options.title: Sponsor the state layer
options.body: Accept this as the maintained internal foundation, with a focused spec update, rebase, and live Convex proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Defer the protocol foundation
recommendation.body: Pause this draft until maintainers approve an end-to-end catalog-feed consumer and transport plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is repository-level product direction rather than a mechanical repair decision.
